reuse.why: Routes every month-wide action through one new selection helper and reuses setBudget/getSheetValue/batchMessages, but hand-rolls a #fixed regex instead of the existing extractTagsFromText in #shared/tags and parses goal_def itself.

duplication.why: Collapses three copies of the category SQL into getMonthWideCategories; only the income/tracking guard and the expense sign flip are repeated in the new setLastMonthSpending, as in the other actions.

placement.why: Selection logic sits in budget/actions.ts next to the actions that use it and the method is registered in app.ts beside its siblings; tag parsing would better live in #shared/tags.

scope.why: Only the budget actions, their registration, tests and release notes are touched.

maintainability.why: One function decides which categories month-wide actions write to, with a single explicit flag for hidden categories; the ad-hoc tag regex and swallow-all JSON parse are minor rough edges.

bypasses_abstraction.where: hasFixedTag in actions.ts uses its own /#fixed/ regex instead of extractTagsFromText from #shared/tags.

disguised_duplication.where: The income/tracking guard and sign flip in setLastMonthSpending are repeated openly in the same form as the sibling actions, not disguised.

abstraction_drift.where: getMonthWideCategories gains includeHiddenCategories (step 4) with one conditional SQL clause; all five month-wide actions (copyPreviousMonth, setZero, setLastMonthSpending, set3/6/12MonthAvg) use it.
